description: Automatic duplex printers help save paper and improve efficiency for home and office use. In India, options are available across price ranges, including laser and ink tank models. The list features HP Laser MFP 323d and HP Laser 303d with 30 ppm speeds and 30,000-page duty cycles. Canon PIXMA G4780, Brother DCP-T535DW, and Epson EcoTank L6460 offer duplex printing with scanning and copying features, Wi-Fi connectivity, and high page yields at prices starting from Rs. 13,999.
title: Best Printers With Automatic Double-Sided Printing in India

description: NASA astronomers using the Chandra X-ray Observatory have discovered a vast, million-degree gas bubble surrounding HD 61005, a 100-million-year-old Sun-like star about 120 light-years away. Its stellar wind is far stronger than today’s solar wind, forming a 200 astronomical unit-wide astrosphere that offers rare insight into how the young Sun once shaped the early solar system.
title: Chandra Detects Giant X-Ray Bubble Around Young Sun-Like Star HD 61005

description: Nike announced the expansion of its running shoe portfolio with the launch of the Nike Pegasus 42 and the new Nike ACG Pegasus Trail in India on Tuesday. As per the company, the latest Pegasus lineup continues its focus on athlete-led design, responsive cushioning, and versatility across surfaces, building on the brand’s five decades of performance innovation. The Pegasus franchise, notably, remains one of Nike’s longest-running and best-selling running lines.
title: Nike Pegasus 42 Running Shoes Launched in India With New Air Zoom Unit, Nike ACG Pegasus Trail Tags Along

description: Honor Magic V6 design has been revealed by the Chinese smartphone maker days ahead of its March 1 global launch. The upcoming foldable smartphone is also confirmed to be launched in China soon. In a post on Weibo, the company has confirmed that the phone will be sold at least in the Red Rabbit (translated from Chinese) colour option. The handset will carry a triple rear camera unit, housed inside a circular camera module on the back. It is also teased to sport a dual LED flash setup. It is shown to feature relatively thin hinges.
title: Honor Magic V6 Design, Red Colourway Teased; Company Touts Durability of Magic V6 Hinge

description: Xiaomi has confirmed global colour options for the Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 17 Ultra ahead of their February 28 launch. The Xiaomi 17 will launch globally in black, blue, and pink, while the Ultra will arrive in Starlit Green. In India, the Xiaomi 17 is teased in black and green, and the Ultra in black. European pricing and configurations have leaked earlier. The features of the phones are known from China, though global variants may feature smaller batteries.
title: Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra Global and Indian Colourways Confirmed as February 28 Launch Event Nears

description: iQOO Z11x has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, revealing its chipset, OS, RAM, and performance numbers. The handset was spotted with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7400 chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM. It was listed with Android 16 and a Mali-G615 MC2 GPU, too. The phone managed to score 1,057 points in single-core performance and 2,704 points in multi-core performance. The listing suggests that the iQOO Z11x got 3,050 points in the OpenCL test.
title: iQOO Z11x Listed on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Chip, Could Launch Soon

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 are expected to be launched in India and other global markets during the upcoming Galaxy Unpacked 2026 event, which is scheduled to take place on Wednesday (February 25) at 10 am PT/1 pm ET (11:30 pm IST) in San Francisco, California. Apart from the new Galaxy S26 series phones, the event is also expected to witness the unveiling of the Galaxy Buds 4 and Galaxy Buds 4 Pro true wireless stereo (TWS). The event will be livestreamed by the South Korean company via Samsung.com, Samsung Newsroom, and Samsung’s YouTube channel.
title: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked Event 2026: From Galaxy S26 Series to Galaxy Buds 4 Lineup, What to Expect

description: Om Shanti Shanti Shantihi is a Telugu comedy-drama starring Tharun Bhascker and Eesha Rebba. The film follows a young woman who battles marital challenges and societal pressure to pursue her dreams. After its theatrical release on January 30, 2026, the movie will stream on Aha Video from March 4, 2026, receiving positive audience response and solid ratings.
title: Om Shanti Shanti Shantihi OTT Release: When and Where to Watch Tharun Bhascker’s Telugu Comedy

description: AI+ Smartphone has launched the NovaPods Go, Pro, and Clips, along with NovaWatch Active, NovaWatch Kids 4G, and Ai+ Wearbuds in India. Prices start at Rs. 699, and sales begin February 27 via Flipkart. All NovaPods models feature 10mm drivers and IPX4 rating, with select variants supporting Bluetooth 6.0 and low latency modes. The smartwatch lineup offers AMOLED display options, Bluetooth calling, health tracking, GPS, and 4G connectivity, depending on the model.
title: AI+ NovaPods Go, NovaPods Pro and NovaPods Clips Launched in India Alongside NovaWatch Active, NovaWatch Kids 4G, and Ai+ Wearbuds

description: Scarpetta is an upcoming crime thriller series starring Nicole Kidman and Jamie Lee Curtis. Based on Patricia Cornwell’s bestselling novel, the show follows a skilled forensic pathologist who unravels complex murder mysteries using expertise and technology. Set to premiere on Prime Video on March 11, 2026, the series is highly anticipated among crime drama fans worldwide.
title: Scarpetta OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Nicole Kidman’s Crime Thriller Series Online?

description: Subedaar is an upcoming action-packed emotional drama starring Anil Kapoor, releasing on March 5, 2026, on Prime Video. The film explores a soldier’s life after service, blending action, family bonds, and intense storytelling for a global audience.
title: Subedaar OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch Anil Kapoor Starrer Online?

description: Realme P4 Lite is now available for purchase in India via Flipkart and the Realme India online store. The new handset is offered in three colourways, dubbed Beach Gold, Obsidian Black, and Sea Blue, and two RAM and storage configurations. The Realme P4 Lite is backed by a 6,300mAh battery. It features 15W wired charging, too. The handset carries a single 13-megapixel camera on the back and a 5-megapixel camera on the front for selfies and video calls. It is powered by an octa core Unisoc T7250 chipset.
title: Realme P4 Lite With 6,300mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Rainbow Six Mobile has been officially launched worldwide on iOS and Android, Ubisoft announced on Monday. It is a free-to-play tactical shooter developed by Ubisoft Montreal in collaboration with several other Ubisoft studios. It is a standalone experience built specifically for smartphones. The game brings the core gameplay loop of the Rainbow Six franchise to mobile devices, featuring competitive 5v5 matches, destructible environments, and operator-based abilities.
title: Ubisoft's Rainbow Six Mobile Now Available Globally on iOS and Android Devices

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra will be backed by a 4,855mAh rated cell, which could be marketed as a 5,000mAh battery, according to a leaked European Union's European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL) listing. Meanwhile, the standard Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26+ models will reportedly pack 4,175mAh and 4,755mAh rated batteries. The South Korean tech giant is expected to market these as 4,200mAh and 4,800mAh cells, respectively. This is in line with previous leaks, which hinted at similar battery capacities for the three handsets.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Battery Capacites Seemingly Confirmed via EPREL Database Listing

description: Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro has debuted in China at CNY 329 (roughly Rs. 4,300). The TWS earbuds feature a 12mm driver, 20Hz to 40KHz frequency range, and support AAC, SBC, and LHDC 5.0 Hi-Res audio. They offer up to 55dB active noise cancellation, Bluetooth 6.0 with dual-device connectivity, and 47ms low latency mode. Oppo claims up to 13 hours of playback without ANC and up to 54 hours total battery life with the charging case.
title: Oppo Enco Air 5 Pro Launched With Up to 55dB ANC, Hi-Res LHDC Audio Support: Price, Features

description: Written and directed by RA. Karthik, Made in Korea is an upcoming Indo-Korean drama film that will land on Netflix soon.
title: Made in Korea OTT Release: Know When and Where to Watch This Upcoming Indo-Korean Drama Film

description: Microsoft announced a leadership shake-up at Xbox last week, confirming the retirement of erstwhile Xbox boss Phil Spencer and the departure of former Xbox president Sarah Bond. A new report sheds light on Bond's tenure and her exit from Xbox, claiming her "Xbox everywhere" strategy failed to win favours at the company.
title: Outgoing Xbox President Sarah Bond's 'Xbox Everywhere' Strategy 'Offended' Employees: Report

description: WhatsApp is developing SIM‑binding support specifically for users with Indian phone numbers, as noted by a feature tracker. This move aims to comply with a directive under the Department of Telecom’s cybersecurity rules, which require messaging apps to verify an active SIM card. A preview of the feature shows the app notifying users that it must confirm the SIM is present in their device.
title: WhatsApp Developing SIM Bindng Feature for Users in India as Meta Works to Comply With DoT's Directive

description: The iQOO 15R was launched in India on Tuesday. It joins its higher-end sibling, the iQOO 15, in the company’s flagship lineup. The latest handset from the Vivo sub-brand sports a 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED screen. It is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip, which also powers the OnePlus 15. The iQOO 15R has a dual rear camera setup, headlined by a 50-megapixel Sony LYT-700V sensor. It packs a 7,600mAh battery.
title: iQOO 15R Launched in India With 144Hz Display, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: iPhone 18 Pro will be launched by the Cupertino-based smartphone maker with a significant upgrade in terms of the camera department, a tipster claims. The upcoming flagship handset could be equipped with a 24-megapixel camera on the front for selfies and videos, which is expected to be housed inside a relatively smaller Dynamic Island feature. The phone is rumoured to be unveiled in India and other global markets later this year, in September. It could be accompanied by the iPhone 18 Pro Max and Apple’s first foldable handset, which could be named the iPhone Fold.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Tipped Launched With Upgraded Selfie Camera

description: OnePlus 15T will debut in China soon, as confirmed by community lead Shuai Lan. The compact flagship is expected to feature a 6.32-inch 1.5K 165Hz OLED display and run on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC with up to 16GB RAM and 1TB storage. It may pack a 7,000mAh to 8,000mAh battery with 100W charging. Leaked camera details vary between triple and dual 50-megapixel setups. A OnePlus 15s variant is also rumoured for global markets.
title: OnePlus 15T Confirmed to Launch in China Soon: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Oppo Find N6 will be launched in China soon, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. Along with the announcement, the tech firm has also teased the front design of the upcoming foldable phone. It is shown to feature relatively thin bezels. Moreover, it is confirmed to be equipped with a Hasselblad-tuned camera unit. However, the company has yet to reveal other details, including the exact launch date, battery, chipset, camera configuration, pricing, and colourways, about the Oppo Find N6. A tipster recently claimed that the handset will be launched in China and select global markets on March 17.
title: Oppo Find N6 Confirmed to Launch in China Soon; Could Support Magnetic Accessories

description: Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 4 Pro have leaked ahead of their February 25 debut at Galaxy Unpacked. According to a new report based on an APK teardown, the earbuds may support head gestures to accept or reject calls, respond to Bixby, and manage notifications. They are also tipped to offer camera remote controls via a pinch gesture and a Find My Phone shortcut through the charging case. Updated renders suggest the case will not include a built-in speaker.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Features Leaked; Might Support Head Gestures, Find My Phone Shortcut

description: The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be unveiled at Apple’s September event, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro Max and the long-rumoured iPhone Fold models. According to a tipster, the purported handset has entered the early stages of test production. Apple is said to have begun limited-scale manufacturing runs of the iPhone 18 Pro as part of its engineering validation and production readiness process, months ahead of its official unveiling.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Enters Test Production Stage With Minimal Material Changes, Tipster Claims

description: Anthropic on Tuesday accused China-based artificial intelligence (AI) companies, including DeepSeek, of attempting to extract knowledge from its AI systems using a technique known as distillation. The US-based AI firm said it detected activity consistent with large-scale model distillation attempts targeting its systems. Anthropic claims the effort was aimed at using outputs from its models to train competing AI systems, and it says it has taken steps to block and prevent such activity.
title: Anthropic Accuses DeepSeek and Other Chinese AI Firms of Model Distillation Attempts

description: The iQOO 15R is all set to launch in India today (Tuesday). It is expected to arrive as the newest addition to the company's flagship lineup, which already comprises the iQOO 15. In the days leading up to its debut, the Vivo sub-brand has revealed a few details about the upcoming handset. It will sport a 1.5K AMOLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. The iQOO 15R is confirmed to be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset.
title: iQOO 15R Launching Today: Know Price in India, Features, Specifications and More
